en.headline: Police investigate video of dog put in running washing machine
en.dek: Mong Kok officers are examining a circulated Instagram story that appears to show a live dog tumbling inside a front-loading machine with water flowing; no arrest has been made.
body: Police said they received an electronic report on Saturday night about a video circulating on social media that appeared to show a dog being treated improperly. The case has been classified for investigation and is being handled by the Mong Kok District animal crime team. No one has been arrested.

Two Instagram stories posted from the same male account on Saturday night appeared to show a live dog, believed to be a young border collie, placed inside a front-loading washing machine that was then switched on. The drum turned with the animal inside while water entered the machine. One of the stories carried the caption “OMG”.

The stories were later removed from the account, either by the poster or after they expired, but copies had already been saved and shared widely online. Netizens expressed anger and reported the material to police. Officers are continuing inquiries.

zh.headline: 影片疑將狗放入洗衣機開動 警列求警調查
zh.dek: 社交平台流傳Instagram限時動態，疑有人將活狗放入滾筒洗衣機並開機，旺角警區動物專隊正跟進，暫未有人被捕。
body: 警方表示，周六晚接獲電子報案，指社交平台流傳一段影片，懷疑有狗隻被不恰當對待。經初步調查，案件列作求警調查，交由旺角警區動物專隊跟進，暫未有人被捕。
兩則Instagram限時動態由同一男子帳戶於周六晚發出，顯示一隻活狗（相信為邊牧幼犬）被放入滾筒式洗衣機，其後機身開動，狗隻連同滾筒滾動，洗衣機同時出水。其中一則動態寫上「OMG」。
相關限時動態其後從帳戶消失，未知是自行刪除或逾時下架，但已被網民備份並廣泛流傳。網民紛紛譴責並報警。警方正繼續調查。
